external/api-keys.txt

WHAT THIS IS
  Every secret the project uses, where it goes, and who holds it. The values go in .env (repo 1,
  one per laptop, gitignored). Never put a key in a committed file, in team chat, or in a prompt.

KEYS
  name               used for                                   needed on      where to get it
  SpacetimeDB        hooks, MCP server, watcher, scripts        every laptop   NOT in .env: `spacetime login` on that laptop,
  session                                                                      then the database owner approves your public
                                                                               identity (module/ACCESS.md). The tools read the
                                                                               session from the CLI. `npm run doctor` checks it.
  FACTORY_API_KEY    Droid SDK diagnosis                        watcher only   Factory dashboard or booth (factory-droid.txt)
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY  Claude fallback diagnosis                  watcher only   console.anthropic.com; ask the Anthropic
                                                                               booth about hackathon credits
  GitHub             pushing wip/* branches                     every laptop   each laptop's normal git login; nothing in .env

NOT SECRET, BUT PER LAPTOP
  COWORK_NAME (a, b, c or d) and, on the watcher, DEMO_REPO_PATH. See .env.example.

IF A KEY LEAKS
  Revoke it in that service's dashboard right away, make a new one, and tell the team.
